gate_fb11_workless.claim: FB11: with each law held at RK3's stages (backward Euler over alpha_k dt at the stage's end), the exchange across an opening is workless to rounding: the law's own books over the stages against the flow's -sum_k alpha_k dt p_k q_k, every step, within 16 eps of the law's own scale
gate_fb11_workless.kind: equality (both sides are the same products; the gate bounds their summation and the face flux's rounding, not the law's accuracy)

prediction.unit: the law identity's worst over its floor (16 eps of its scale)
prediction.why: the flow and the law book the same p_k and q_k; what differs is the rows' flux against the face flux (a summation floor carried through the block, in the scale) and the BE law's own algebra, a few eps

control.plant: law_once: each law held over the whole step at its start (rows BE over dt at the step's end at every stage), advanced once with the last stage's flux and pressure; the flow still books its stages: the residual sum_k alpha_k dt (p_k q_k - p_3 q_3), first order in dt
control.resolution: pulsatile draws move p q by about 2 pi x 0.3 / 40 of itself a step: the residual is about 1e-2 of the law's scale, 1e12 floors in float64 and 1e4 in float32

gate_fb11_workless.if_wrong: a clean draw over its floor: the floor misses a rounding (look at the face flux against the rows' flux) or the per-stage books do not telescope; a missed control: the plant moves nothing the books read
gate_fb11_workless.cannot_discriminate_if: steady flow (p q constant over the step: the control's residual vanishes); the draws are pulsatile

gate_route_one.claim: F1b's per-step route-1 check on the open RK3 node: no step gives energy (the laws' storage counted with the flow's: a discharging Windkessel is no gift), and a gift on one step is counted on that step
gate_route_one.kind: acceptance (route 1 judges the sign of each step's dissipation; it bounds nothing about its size)

prediction.unit: steps counted negative on clean draws
prediction.why: the step's true dissipation (viscous, penalty, the laws' losses and N_WK, the backflow term's) is positive and far above RK3's penalty-split residual (1e-6 of the port energy in the spike)

control.plant: gift_once: on step 10 alone the stepped velocity scaled so the kinetic energy rises by twice that step's dissipation by formula, the laws' losses and numerical terms included
control.expected_rate: 40/40 each dtype, exactly one step counted
control.resolution: a gift is counted where it exceeds the step's true dissipation (D - G < 0); one of twice the formula's dissipation is counted unless RK3's residual exceeds the formula's dissipation

gate_route_one.if_wrong: a clean step counted: the storage or a law's books are read at the wrong instant (a jump between steps), or a Windkessel's release is read as a gift; a missed gift: the plant's dissipation is not the account's
gate_route_one.cannot_discriminate_if: a gift smaller than the step's dissipation (it is not a sign change); the plant is sized from the step's own terms

gate_inflow_rk3.claim: FB2 under RK3: the inflow's face flux at the step's end is its waveform there (the last stage's end) to its summation floor

prediction.unit: |q + Q(t)| over (N + 2) eps 4 h^2 sum|w| + the waveform's own
prediction.why: the flux row pins q at each stage's end; the last stage ends at the step's end

control.plant: inflow_scaled: the row's flux 1.001 times the waveform
control.expected_rate: 40/40 in float64; in float32 the floor is about (N + 2) 4 eps = 2e-4 at 400 faces, so a 1e-3 plant is about 5 floors: expected caught, rate measured

gate_inflow_rk3.if_wrong: the stage instant is not the stage's end (the last stage's flux off the step-end waveform by a stage's change)
gate_inflow_rk3.cannot_discriminate_if: a steady inflow (the instant does not matter): the draws are pulsatile

gate_affine_rk3.claim: SF-12's affine case under RK3: the step superposed from each stage's unit fields equals the same step taken with each stage's openings' forces at the relative pressures it solved and projected plainly

prediction.unit: largest difference over the largest speed, float64; float32 band [0, 3e-6]
prediction.why: both are the same stage arithmetic up to the superposition's rounding: fast solves, no tolerance

control.plant: unit_scaled: every unit field (its velocity, pressure increment and penalised field) times 1.1
control.expected_rate: every run in float64; float32 measured
control.resolution: the moves are a stage's change of the relative pressures (the prediction is the last stage's), so the plant moves the field by 0.1 m U: guessed 1e-6 to 1e-3 of the largest speed

gate_affine_rk3.if_wrong: a clean draw above the band: the superposition and the stage's own projection differ in an operation (the penalty's division of the unit force, the pressure's increment)
gate_affine_rk3.cannot_discriminate_if: moves of zero (a steady state with an exact prediction): the draw is pulsatile and 4 steps from a swirled start

gate_zero_start.claim: decision 14 under the gauge: RK3 with ports starts from a pressure consistent with its velocity and its openings (made in the program at a step whose pressure is unmade); what a zero start (field pressure and the openings' prediction zero) does is measured, not assumed
gate_zero_start.kind: estimates (the start's transient); the spike's divergence is a measurement of another formulation
gate_zero_start.case: the spike's question 7 on this node: a pressure inlet P0 (1 + 0.3 cos wt), an RCR outlet at R_p 0.5, 30, 100 R_tube, nu 0.005, R 0.5, alpha 6, D/h 16, 4 D long, interior 0.01h, 350 steps a period, half a period (probe arm zero_start)

prediction.unit: the largest transverse speed in the first 5 steps over the mean speed, and finiteness
prediction.why: [inference] the field sees each opening's pressure relative to the gauge's reference, so the level the spike's zero start had to absorb (which grew with R_p and drove its divergence) never reaches the field: the zero start here misses only the vessel's own drop. Predicted: the consistent start's transverse speed at rounding (under 1e-12 of the mean); the zero start finite at every R_p, its transverse kick 1e-3 to 0.3 of the mean speed, not growing with R_p. If it does diverge, the gauge does not shield the start and the control is the spike's

gate_zero_start.control: if the zero start does not diverge, the control of 'refused otherwise' is the kick: the zero start's transverse speed over the consistent start's, above 1e6 on every R_p; the record's divergence is then not reproduced here and that is stated (a test that cannot discriminate is not a null result)
gate_zero_start.if_wrong: a consistent start with a kick: the start's port system or its pressure is not the stage's; a divergence of the zero start: the gauge does not keep the level out

gate_fixed_point.claim: the open tube's RK3 fixed point (Stokes, an open stenosis, pressures given at both ends) is the steady open solve's on the same grid (the open-ports spike: 1.3e-12): the openings' forces enter each stage at the pressure's weight
gate_fixed_point.kind: equality (to the CG's tolerance and RK3's convergence)
gate_fixed_point.case: test_fvm_open_rk3: D/h 8, 2 D long, a narrowing 0.4, convection off, GivenPressure at both ends, RK3 run to its fixed point against NarrowedOpenNode's steady solve at tolerance 1e-11

prediction.unit: largest difference over the largest speed
prediction.why: RK3's fixed point is the discrete Brinkman problem whatever dt (B2); the run's own convergence and the CG's tolerance bound the difference

control.plant: forces_at_gamma: the openings' forces taken at the drive's weight gamma_k dt (gamma_k / alpha_k = 1, 3.125, 2.25)
control.expected_rate: every run (the fixed point's port force is 2 to 3 times off: the flux moves by order one)

gate_r8.claim: R-8: the Windkessel under RK3 is first order in time: its N_WK, a stage's capacitor change squared, summed over a fixed time falls as dt (Windkessel.orders, order 2 a step)
gate_r8.kind: estimates (the law's order; the tolerance of any Windkessel gate under RK3 states first order)
gate_r8.case: test_fvm_open_rk3.test_r8_the_windkessel_under_rk3_is_first_order: term_orders over three drawn cases at D/h 8

prediction.unit: ratio of the sums at dt and dt/2
prediction.why: backward Euler per stage over alpha_k dt: N_WK = (C/2)(dPc)^2 with dPc of order alpha_k dt

gate_fb7_backflow.claim: FB7: at S1's point (mean Re 300 on the radius, alpha 5.5, a 50 % cosine stenosis of the radius 1 D long centred 0.9 D before the outlet, D/h 16, 4 D long, interior 0.01h, the reversing inflow Q_m (1 + 1.5 sin wt), an RCR outlet R_p 0.5, C 0.4, R_d 5 in S1's units, dt 0.8 h over 60 times the mean speed), RK3 with ports diverges without the backflow term and holds with it
gate_fb7_backflow.kind: acceptance (a stability check at one point; the threshold and the tangential share are estimates)
gate_fb7_backflow.case: probe arms fb7_* (probe/fb7.py): 5 draws, the stenosis's centre 0.7 to 1.1 D before the outlet and the inflow's phase drawn; each arm with and without the term, 0.6 of a period (about 7,500 steps) or until it diverges

prediction.value: without: 5/5 diverge within 0.5 of a period; with: 5/5 finite and bounded (largest speed under 20 times the mean) over 0.6 of a period
prediction.basis: measured-before (the spike, 1 of 1) and guess (the draws)
prediction.why: the stenotic jet's recirculation reaches the outlet near the forward peak and the reversed inflow's kinetic energy feeds the instability; the term removes it on the normal component

threshold.value: without the term: finite at Re_R 100 and 150, divergent at 300; onset between 150 and 300
threshold.basis: guess (the spike: stable at 100 with the stenosis 1.4 D before, divergent at 300 at 0.9 D)

tangential_share.unit: the tangential components' share of the kinetic energy entering through reversed outlet faces, with the term, over the run's reversed steps (median)
tangential_share.why: the jet's recirculation swirls; the term acts on the normal component only (R-15: the normal-only affine form kept)

damping.unit: 1 - (the reversed outlet flux's largest magnitude with the term) / (without), at a stable reversing point (Re_R 100, the stenosis 1.4 D before)
damping.basis: guess (the spike: outlet w min -0.84 without, -0.71 with: 0.15)

control.expected_rate: 5/5 diverge (the control is the gate's other arm)

gate_fb7_backflow.if_wrong: no divergence without the term: the point is not past the instability on this node (the evolved flux inlet, the fluid-weighted term) and FB7 cannot discriminate; say so and move the point (Re up, the stenosis nearer), never read it as 'not needed'
gate_fb7_backflow.cannot_discriminate_if: both arms finite (no instability reached) or both diverge (the term does not hold here)

gate_fb10_entrance.case: probe arms fb10_* (probe/fb10.py): Re 100 and 300 by the diameter, a 26 D tube at D/h 16, a plug start, steady Inflow, a pressure outlet, run to steady state (3 flow-through times); L_99 where the centreline speed first reaches 0.99 of its last tenth's

prediction.value: L_99 / the correlation's in [0.3, 1.5] at both Re
prediction.why: the half cell's own convective flux keeps the inlet face near a plug at high Re; the Stokes control's development is a fraction of a diameter

control.plant: convection off (stokes=True) at the same flux: L_99 about 0.6 D, outside the band at both Re

gate_fb10_entrance.cannot_discriminate_if: the inlet face already developed (L_99 under a diameter with convection on): then the gate shows the face is not a plug, stated
